caveats: Previews are simulations at the current state version; they are never signed or submitted. No private keys or secrets were used or written.

USD values are the protocols' own API valuations (Ociswap api.ociswap.com/pools, DefiPlaza radix.defiplaza.net/api/pairs) cross-checked against on-chain vault balances for the top pools; XRD=$0.00045198 (coins.llama.fi / CoinGecko). Memecoin legs of long-tail pools may be illiquid and the API's USD TVL should be treated as an upper bound.

Ociswap long-tail coverage: hooks were verified empty for the 45 largest live pools ($34.3k of $44.9k TVL). The remaining ~533 live pools hold ~$10.6k combined; their public surface is the same 4 blueprints (no per-pool custom code), so hook-free status is expected but not individually verified for every one.

The legacy Ociswap 'BasicPool' package (package_rdx1p5l6...) source is not present in the public Ociswap repositories found (ociswap/pool is the v2 line); its interface was enumerated from the on-chain blueprint schema and its public methods were probed live (no flash_loan, no hooks, 4-field state, add/remove are native TwoResourcePool contribute/redeem).

The DefiPlaza main-DEX PlazaPair build is older than the repo HEAD/audit-final commit (roken by the missing get_state view functions and a different panic string). The audit's H01 (token loss on add_liquidity during shortage) is fixed in the audited final code; the live older build could not be diffed (audit commits are not public), so it is flagged as a residual unknown, mitigated by the live value-conserving test of exactly that path (net 0.0).
No cross-transaction price-manipulation (TWAP decay) or multi-epoch tests were run: previews execute at the current clock, so only same-transaction manipulations could be simulated.
